description: This file defines the LeaseBasedQueueBalancerOptions class, which contains configuration settings for the LeaseBasedQueueBalancer used in Orleans stream providers. It includes properties for lease length, renewal period, acquisition period, and lease category, along with default values and obsolete properties for backward compatibility.
